headline: US stocks set to open higher in holiday-shortened session as tech and AI sentiment steadies ahead of jobless claims and trade data
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) rise 1.97% in a gap-up move after the S&P 500 slipped 0.25% in the prior session
- Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) gain 2.84% as investors return to recently pressured technology and AI names amid stabilizing AI jitters
- Dow Jones futures (@YM) advance 1.33% and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) climb 1.55% in early post-Thanksgiving trade
- X Financial (XYF) reports earnings before the bell on a light pre-market slate, with reactions still developing
- Asian and European equity markets trade higher overnight as oil and gold futures (@GC) also move up
- US economic data at 8:30 AM ET include initial jobless claims, continuing jobless claims, and the advance goods trade balance
- Wholesale inventories are scheduled for release at 8:30 AM ET
- US equity markets follow an early schedule with a 1:00 PM ET close for the post-Thanksgiving session
- Overnight narrative leans on post-4 AM ET reporting, including a 04:18 ET Yahoo Finance note highlighting stabilization in AI sentiment rather than a single high-impact catalyst
